research.title: Robust Covariance Estimation for Heavy-Tailed Classification
bullets: Formulated a research question on how heavy-tailed feature distributions affect covariance estimation and downstream uncertainty in discriminant classifiers.
Led development of a robust shrinkage estimator combining truncated covariance estimates with diagonal regularization; evaluated classification error and calibration under contamination.

research.title: Adaptive Importance Weighting for Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated a research question on stabilizing weighted conformal prediction when estimated density ratios concentrate on sparse regions of feature space.
Led development of adaptive weight clipping and effective sample size diagnostics; evaluated coverage and interval width across controlled covariate shifts.

projects.title: Kernel Ridge Regression with Approximate Feature Maps
bullets: Implemented exact kernel ridge regression, random Fourier features, and Nyström approximations using shared preprocessing and regularization selection procedures.
Compared predictive error, memory requirements, and training time across feature dimensions; examined sensitivity to kernel bandwidth and approximation randomness.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Estimation with Missing Features
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixtures with incomplete observations, computing conditional sufficient statistics during the expectation step.
Compared clustering stability and held-out likelihood against mean-imputation baselines under random missingness; inspected sensitivity to initialization and covariance regularization.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Probabilistic Classifier Calibration
bullets: Implemented temperature scaling, Platt scaling, and isotonic regression for classifier probability calibration using separate fitting and evaluation partitions.
Compared log loss, Brier score, and reliability diagrams across class imbalance settings; examined how calibration sample size affected method selection.
